notes: All 20 request methods, paths, parameters, bodies and authentication were checked against the pinned official OpenAPI 3.1 spec.

18 responses use the official reference pages displayed JSON examples. The two label responses use the full pinned schema witness in the harness: its source auditor does not HTML-unescape the displayed <string> placeholder. Unmodified documented label bodies and source URLs are covered by the mock fixtures.
No live account or provider writes were used.
The api_access_token header supports existing Chatwoot releases; the latest spec also offers Bearer authentication starting with v4.19.0.
